material_findings.title: UGREEN Hackathon 2026 on AI NAS
material_findings.entry_cost: No purchase or payment required; initial round does not require a NAS. Finalists receive one assigned free remote NAS test day.
material_findings.eligibility: Adult individual or team of up to three; US included; geographic exclusions apply; companies/organizations excluded. Participant registration not independently confirmed.
material_findings.requirements: Original UGOS AI NAS skill using official Uliya SKILL.md format and supported CLI/expert agents; round 1 PDF plus ZIP <=10 MB, no executable scripts or arbitrary NAS access; up to 30 finalists; final working skill plus <3 minute public YouTube demo.
material_findings.authorization: Competition rules permit only contest-provided development and assigned finalist NAS testing; no permission to test any other NAS or network.
